answer: Require every agent to post a stake that is slashed if a randomly sampled interaction is proven fraudulent: peers challenge claims with signed evidence, and an adjudicator checks the record before releasing the stake. Creating a fable of many fake identities then does not multiply influence for free; each identity needs capital locked up, and detected collusion burns it. Raising the attack’s scale becomes a costly spiral, while honest agents can build reputation gradually across the meadow of ordinary exchanges.
